# Apocalypse of Peter — Chapter 16
**Agent:** EMET (Literal)
**Source:** Akhmim Fragment / Ethiopic MS, Apocalypse of Peter 16

---

*[The transfigured righteous. The garden. The disciples' response. The Ascension vision.]*

1. And we, the twelve disciples, beheld him as though he had been taken up into the heavens, and the brightness of the light which was in him did not cease.

2. And I saw all the righteous who were there with him, and they shone with brightness ten times greater than that of the sun. Their whiteness was more white than any snow.

3. And the joy of those who dwelt in paradise was great, for they greatly praised the Lord, they and all the angels who praised him together.

4. And the Lord asked us: "Do you behold the glory that is here? Do you see those who are with me? And what will be the end of this vision?"

5. And we answered him: "We do not understand this. For before we could utter a word, our understanding was taken from us."

6. And the Lord said to me: "Go and tell all those who are to enter into my kingdom in the same manner as Abraham and Isaac and Jacob. And to all of these shall be given the crown of faith."

7. And I said to him: "Lord, will you permit me to speak two words, to make you understand what I am speaking?"

8. And he said to me: "Speak what you wish, my Lord."

9. And I said to him: "A great light has appeared before us this day. A light more beautiful than any. And if it is possible, let us make three tabernacles — one for you, and one for Moses, and one for Elijah."

10. And he said to me: "You see the kingdom of heaven in advance, Peter."

---
*EMET note: Peter's proposal to build three tabernacles (v.9) directly parallels Mark 9:5 and parr. The Transfiguration account in the APE and in the synoptic Gospels are clearly related — it is debated which direction the dependency runs.*
